description: Return a Seenly signup URL for a job seeker. The link opens the start page so the seeker can create their own account in the browser. Pass the calling product or assistant name as agent_name so signups can be attributed. Never create the account yourself.

agent_name.description: Name of the calling assistant or product, for example claude, chatgpt, or career-coach.

name: get_signup_link
title: Get Seenly signup link
